errors.evidence: The segments are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, the largest segment 'Übrige' (38.1%) is followed by 'Kultur' (2.2%), which is one of the smallest.
The chart shows 14 distinct categories (segments), not 11. The description omits 'Abfallwirtschaft', 'Gasversorgung', and 'Kombinierte Versorgung'.

The description fails to state that each category has two percentage values, one for 2014 (inner circle) and one for 2021 (outer circle). It only lists a single, inconsistently selected value for each segment, thereby missing the core comparative purpose of the chart.
The value 31.1% is associated with the category 'Übrige' for the year 2021. The correct values for 'Wohnungswesen' are 7.2% (2014) and 8.4% (2021).
The value 6.2% is associated with either 'Wirtschaftsförderung' (2021) or 'Kombinierte Versorgung' (2021). The correct values for 'Kliniken' are 3.2% (2014) and 4.5% (2021).

errors.evidence: The percentage values are located outside the donut chart rings, not inside the segments. They are connected to their respective segments with leader lines.
The description omits three categories shown in the chart: 'Abfallwirtschaft' (waste management), 'Gasversorgung' (gas supply), and 'Kombinierte Versorgung' (combined supply).
